summary: Full backend (PHPUnit/Feature) + frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080, dark mode, mobile 390px) testing of the new Analisa Kredit module (Analisa Usaha 4 tipe, Analisa Keuangan, Analisa Kepemilikan) in /app/adminkit. Added 10 new feature tests (tests/Feature/AnalysisModuleExtraTest.php) covering Jasa/Lainnya metrics, per-group item sync, ownership persistence, delete, validation and authorization; full suite now 81 passed / 1 failed (the single failure is a real minor defect, see backend_issues.minor). E2E as Staff Analis 350010923 on berkas 11: created Perdagangan/Pertanian/Jasa/Lainnya usaha with auto codes (AUPG00002/AUP00001/AUJ00002/AUL00001), verified every calculated field matches the legacy examples (margin 40,63% -> omset 492.205, laba bulanan 4.266.150, hasil bersih 3.816.150; panen 65x650k = 42.250.000, biaya 14.878.571, pendapatan perbulan 2.728.572; jasa 5jt-1jt = 4jt; lainnya 8jt-2jt-300rb+500rb = 6.200.000), persistence after reload, income/expense rows not overwriting each other, Analisa Keuangan aggregation per tipe (total 41.387.579 -> keuangan perbulan 39.067.579), Analisa Kepemilikan (all 8 combobox + Harta Lain persist), badge 'Belum diisi' -> 'Sudah diisi', delete usaha (redirect back + row removed), 404 for a berkas that is not the analyst's assignment and for a non-existent business id, dark mode and 390px mobile with no horizontal overflow. All test data created during the run was cleaned up.

minor.issue: AnalysisBusinessController::update() maps every field with `$value ?? 0`, so clearing a nullable *string* select stores the literal '0': sending business_length=null persists '0' (test test_business_length_null_is_not_stored_as_zero fails). Same risk for economy_sector, plant_type, business_kind and address. Apply the `?? 0` default only to numeric columns (money/area/qty) and keep null for enum/text columns; the stored '0' is not a member of LENGTHS so the Combobox will render nothing while the DB holds junk.

Pendapatan Usaha sums AnalysisBusiness.net_profit for ALL types, but for PERTANIAN net_profit is the profit of a full 6-month harvest cycle (Rp 27.696.429 in the test), while the sheet presents a PER MONTH capability (Keuangan Perbulan). Verified in UI: kartu 'Usaha Pertanian' showed Rp 27.371.429 and Keuangan Perbulan Rp 39.067.579, i.e. farm income is counted ~6x too high. The per-month figure (farmMetrics()['monthly_income']) is already computed but never used by the sheet. Please confirm against the legacy form.

Field 'AMBIL 70%' (take_portion) is validated, saved and rendered but is not used in any formula (neither farmMetrics() nor analysisMath.js). Either wire it into the calculation or mark it informational.

issues: Badge 'Hasil Bersih' in the page header only reflects the server value, so right after typing (before Simpan) it still shows Rp 0 while the card already shows the live result - slightly confusing but consistent after save.

action_items: Fix the `?? 0` default in AnalysisBusinessController::update() so nullable enum/text fields (business_length, economy_sector, plant_type, business_kind, address) stay null instead of '0'.
Decide/confirm how PERTANIAN income enters Bagian 2 (net per harvest cycle vs monthly_income) - current sheet total overstates monthly capability.
Wire 'AMBIL 70%' (take_portion) into the farm calculation or clearly mark it as informational.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalysisBusinessController::update() deletes items only for the submitted `groups` and re-creates all `items` - correct and verified, but there is no guard that every submitted item's group is contained in `groups`; a payload with an item outside `groups` would duplicate rows. Add a validation rule items.*.group in groups.
AnalysisBusiness::metrics() builds a `$sum` closure that is only used by otherMetrics() - minor dead code for the other three branches.
All money/derived fields are read-only FieldStat components and computed in analysisMath.js mirroring the backend; both matched exactly on every scenario tested (no drift found).

success_rate.backend: 98% (81/82 tests; single failure is the documented '0' default defect)

Str::upper($v) : ($v ?? 0))` coerces every non-name/address null to integer 0, including enum string columns. Reproduce: PUT businesses/{id} with business_length=null -> DB column contains '0'.
